items.question: How many scheduled flights does each airline have? Show airline codes and flight counts.
items.reference_sql: SELECT f~carrier_id, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM /dmo/flight AS f GROUP BY f~carrier_id

items.question: Show the 5 scheduled flights with the largest seating capacities, including airline codes, route numbers, dates and capacities. Sort by capacity, largest first, then by date, airline code and route number.
items.reference_sql: SELECT f~carrier_id, f~connection_id, f~flight_date, f~seats_max FROM /dmo/flight AS f ORDER BY f~seats_max DESCENDING, f~flight_date ASCENDING, f~carrier_id ASCENDING, f~connection_id ASCENDING UP TO 5 ROWS

items.question: Show the 10 most expensive trips priced in euros, with trip numbers and total prices, highest price first, then by trip number.
items.reference_sql: SELECT t~travel_id, t~total_price FROM /dmo/travel AS t WHERE t~currency_code = 'EUR' ORDER BY t~total_price DESCENDING, t~travel_id ASCENDING UP TO 10 ROWS

items.question: Which 10 agencies have the most trips? Show agency numbers and trip counts, most trips first, then by agency number.
items.reference_sql: SELECT t~agency_id, COUNT(*) AS trip_count FROM /dmo/travel AS t GROUP BY t~agency_id ORDER BY trip_count DESCENDING, t~agency_id ASCENDING UP TO 10 ROWS

items.question: Which cities do our customers live in? Show each city and country code combination once, sorted by country code and then city.
items.reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c~city, c~country_code FROM /dmo/customer AS c ORDER BY c~country_code ASCENDING, c~city ASCENDING

items.question: Which cities have more than one airport listed? Show cities, country codes and airport counts.
items.reference_sql: SELECT a~city, a~country, COUNT(*) AS airport_count FROM /dmo/airport AS a GROUP BY a~city, a~country HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

items.question: How many airlines use each currency? Show currency codes and airline counts.
items.reference_sql: SELECT c~currency_code, COUNT(*) AS airline_count FROM /dmo/carrier AS c GROUP BY c~currency_code

items.question: How many flight bookings are recorded in total?
items.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS booking_count FROM /dmo/booking AS b

items.question: List up to 20 available extras, showing their codes, category codes, prices and currencies, sorted by extra code.
items.reference_sql: SELECT s~supplement_id, s~supplement_category, s~price, s~currency_code FROM /dmo/supplement AS s ORDER BY s~supplement_id ASCENDING UP TO 20 ROWS

items.question: Show the 10 trips with the latest end dates, including trip numbers, start dates and end dates. Sort by end date, latest first, then by trip number.
items.reference_sql: SELECT t~travel_id, t~begin_date, t~end_date FROM /dmo/travel AS t ORDER BY t~end_date DESCENDING, t~travel_id ASCENDING UP TO 10 ROWS
